title: Kansas City, St. Louis, the Bay Area, England and the Apollo
summary: A run of dates in Kansas City, Topeka, St. Louis, Oakland for Slim Jenkins, back to Texas, then England with Frankie Newton.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: And then, I left and went back to Kansas City to play some dates there at a hotel there called the Theresa Hotel. So I played there a coupla weeks. Then I went to Topeka, Kansas...played up there for a coupla weeks...came back to Kansas City...hung around there for a coupla weeks, just havin' fun...goofin' off, as some people say. Then I went to St. Louis. I went into St. Louis, played a nightclub there for about

a month, left outa St. Louis, come back to California. Then I went up in 'Frisco, played up in 'Frisco an' I played up in Oakland, California 'bout three or four months. I met a cat up there called Ernie Williams. He was a piano player, an' I met some o' my old friends from Kansas City. They was there playin' at the same nightclub, an' I left that nightclub, went to another nightclub on the corner 'bout a block-and-a-half from the place where I was workin' at. Worked for Slim Jenkins. He had a nightclub up there. And I worked for Slim Jenkins maybe about a month...month-and-a-half...then I took off again...went back down in Texas. Went to Texas...played one-nighters and fooled around down there for about two...three months. Then I left Texas an' I come back home. I drove out, all the way from Houston, Texas. We drove out here. Then I went back to see about my place o' business that I had, the Blue Room. My sister was runnin' it for me, an' the business had went down so bad. I got disappointed with that so I run off to New York again an' we left New York...went to England. Went over in England, played with Frankie Newton and his band. We played all over in...in the country over there, and then I got on a plane an' came back over in the states, an' we wound up goin' back to New York in the Apollo Theater. Worked in the Apollo Theater...me an' Wynonie Harris an' a few other good names in the show. Cut it off [the tape recorder]. Oh, yeah, we back again. Oh yeah. I took off and went to Paris.
